answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the vault release is logged with every signature, the whisper audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the kernel graph and each risks its bond. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
